name: conwayresearch/underdog-woof
title: Underdog Woof is a 31 to 41 MB CPU TTS with measured hard-case word error
summary: Conway Research released Underdog Woof, a tiny English text-to-speech model that runs on CPU with numpy only. The one-voice build is 31.7 MB; the two-voice Hugging Face build is 40.6 MB and reports 1.42% word error on Gradium TTS Hard Cases with about 13.8x real-time on one M5 Max CPU thread. License is non-commercial by default.
